tests.prompt: How long do I have to send an item back?
tests.expected: The assistant should answer using only information from the FAQ about the return window (30 days from delivery, unused, original packaging), without inventing details or redirecting to a human.

tests.prompt: Your checkout page crashes every time I click the Pay button.
tests.expected: The assistant should recognize this as a bug report and ask clarifying questions one at a time to collect a description, steps to reproduce, and environment, rather than calling the bug report tool immediately. It should not call the tool until all three fields are collected, and should give the customer a single ticket ID once it does.

tests.prompt: Can you give me a discount code for my next order?
tests.expected: The assistant should recognize this is neither a bug report nor answerable from the FAQ, and should politely redirect the customer to the human support phone line instead of attempting to answer or offering a discount.
